title: ISO 1219-1:2012 — Fluid power systems and components — Graphical symbols and circuit diagrams — Part 1: Graphical symbols for conventional use and data-processing applications
locator: Abstract: establishes basic elements/rules for devising fluid-power symbols used on components and in circuit diagrams.
notes: Official catalogue indicates the 2012 edition was reviewed and confirmed in 2026 and has Amendment 1:2016. This part concerns symbols; it should not be described as the complete set of circuit diagram construction rules or a component performance standard.
